replication.target_description: Relationship between object working memory and mental rotation. Located candidate families: Table 1  GLMM for dependent-variable mental-rotation response time—Experiment 1; Table 2  GLMM for dependent-variable mental-rotation accuracy—Experiment 1; Table 3  GLMM for dependent-variable working-memory accuracy—Experiment 1. Exact target unresolved.

n.sample_role: Candidate final participant count: Experiment 1 = 119. Trial-level data are the model observation unit; participants are random-effect grouping units. Target-specific usable trial counts are not established. Printed candidate participant counts are withheld from n.value because the target model/test is unresolved.
n.exclusions: Experiment 1: 16 participants excluded for single-task accuracy below 60%; Experiment 2: two missing entirely and 39 excluded for single-task accuracy below 60%. Response times faster than 100 ms or slower than 3,000 ms excluded from all analyses; response-time analyses use correct mental-rotation responses only. Analysis section phrases participant criterion as 60% or lower. Sex analyses separately exclude one nondisclosing participant in Experiment 2. No target-specific retained observation count is established.
n.location: canonical PDF-text p. 3, Participants; pp. 5–6, Data analysis
n.quote: Of the 119 participants in Experiment 1, 57 were men

notes: Identity independently accepted from canonical first-page title, all five authors, DOI 10.3758/s13423-024-02602-4, registered-report/replication heading and accepted date 2 October 2024, with Methods, Results, Tables 1–9 and references present. This is the full primary Ebert et al. replication report, not a preregistration or abstract-only excerpt. Reference gives online year 2024 and later issue pagination; canonical source uses PDF page positions. No PDF path was supplied, so no PDF was rendered. Description and study identifier do not name an outcome (mental-rotation response time, mental-rotation accuracy, or working-memory accuracy) or predictor (condition, rotation, interaction). The p. 7 locator contains Experiment 1 response-time Table 1 with multiple predictors; it does not uniquely identify a test. No mapping by input order, row number, or numeric correspondence was used. Candidate final participant count: Experiment 1 = 119. Trial-level data are the model observation unit; participants are random-effect grouping units. Target-specific usable trial counts are not established. Printed candidate participant counts are withheld from n.value because the target model/test is unresolved.
